builder.title: Builder
builder.cleared: The page is empty. Undo brings it back.
builder.exportNote: Paste it into the template of a component of your Application.
builder.importNote: The template replaces the page; Undo brings the page back.
builder.appNote: One HTML file runs alone: open it from the disk or put it on any server (the framework and ElemenxUI are inside it, about 1.7 MB). The project is a zip for elemenx dev and elemenx build, which keeps only what the page uses.
builder.newNote: What a project makes stays its own: a template, a component or a whole application.

kinds.templateText: One page as a template, to copy into an application.
kinds.componentText: A Component with its public properties and slots, for the inspector.
kinds.applicationText: Pages and components, routes and guards, and the settings of the Application.

builder.fileFailed: This file holds no project of the builder.

disk.title: Project files
disk.note: The files of the project stay as they are: a Component picked here opens as a copy, kept in this browser.
disk.notCopied: The Component {name} is not here to copy: the framework has one of that name already, or its file did not run.
disk.notApplication: A copy of {name} goes into an application: create one, or open the application of this project.
